Header & Controls:
- Breadcrumbs: Admin > Insights > Analytics (with live sync badge "Live Sync")
- Title: "Analytics & Intelligence"
- Description: "Real-time institutional performance metrics, cohort sales velocity, revenue waterfall, and student retention telemetry."
- Top Right Actions: Date range picker preset dropdown ("Last 30 Days (Oct 1 - Oct 31, 2024)" with calendar icon), filter button, and an outlined "Export Report" (with download icon) plus a primary indigo button "Custom Cohort Analysis" or "Schedule Dispatch".

KPI Strip (4 KPI stat cards with trend badges, period comparison, and mini sparklines):
1. Total Revenue: "₹6,12,400" (or "₹6.12L"), +18% vs last month (green badge), target ₹6.0L achieved, gross ₹6.48L / refunds ₹36K.
2. New Students: "142", +24% MoM, active trial-to-paid conversion 34.2%.
3. Course Sales: "218 orders", +12% MoM, avg order value ₹2,809.
4. Avg. Completion Rate: "71.4%", +4.2% vs Q3 benchmark, target threshold 80%.

Executive Insight Callout Cards Strip:
- Insight Card 1 (Key Revenue Driver): "Excel Masterclass drives 41.8% of net revenue" with an inline SVG sparkline graph and badge "Top Performer", noting ₹2.56L generated across 74 cohort enrollments.
- Insight Card 2 (Behavioral Trend): "Weekend Registrations 2.3x higher" with an indicator badge, highlighting Saturday & Sunday surge in corporate learner checkouts.
- Insight Card 3 (Engagement Velocity): "Power Query Capstone submission velocity up 19%", average certificate turnaround down to 4.2 days.

Charts & Data Visualizations Grid (Rendered using rich, crisp SVG vector charts with labels, axes, tooltips, and legends, Recharts / Tremor / Stripe style):
1. Large Main Area Chart: "Revenue Waterfall & Trend (Last 12 Months)"
   - Toggle filters: "Gross Revenue vs Net After Refunds", monthly breakdown (Nov to Oct), dual shaded SVG area curves (Indigo-600 #4F46E5 with soft gradient fill for Gross, and Violet-400 / Teal for Net after refunds).
   - Data callout tooltip on Oct peak: "Oct 2024: Gross ₹6.48L | Net ₹6.12L | Refunds 5.5%".
   - Legend with active indicators.

2. Side-by-Side Charts Row:
   - Left Chart: "Course Sales Velocity" (Horizontal bar chart by course)
     * Advanced Excel Masterclass: 92 sales (₹3.22L)
     * SQL for Modern Data Analysis: 58 sales (₹1.74L)
     * Power Query & ETL Pipelines: 44 sales (₹1.10L)
     * Python for Business Dashboards: 24 sales (₹0.72L)
     Include clean bar fills, count badges, and revenue metrics.
   - Right Chart: "Weekly Student Registrations" (Smooth line chart with dotted target line and weekly datapoints: W1: 28, W2: 34, W3: 31, W4: 49) showing weekend registration spikes with amber highlight dot.

3. Second Visualizations Row:
   - Left Chart: "Enrollment Trends by Category" (Multi-layer stacked area or grouped distribution chart across: Financial Modeling, Data Warehousing, Automation & ETL, Python BI).
   - Right Chart: "Completion Rates by Course" (Horizontal progress bars with a vertical dashed target benchmark line at 80%):
     * Advanced Excel: 84% (Above Target) - emerald green
     * SQL & Data Warehousing: 76% (Near Target) - indigo
     * Power Query & ETL: 68% - indigo
     * Python Dashboards: 58% - amber

4. Comprehensive Data Table: "Top Performing Masterclasses"
   - Columns: Course Name & Category, Total Students, Enrolled This Month, Conversion Rate, Avg Time to Finish, Refund Rate, Total Net Revenue, Trend.
   - 4-5 well-detailed rows matching BICE LMS curriculum:
     * Advanced Excel Masterclass: Dynamic Arrays & Financial Modeling (Active, 1,420 students, 92 this mo, 8.4% conv, 14.2 days, 1.2% refund, ₹3,21,908, positive sparkline)
     * SQL for Modern Data Analysis & Warehousing (Active, 980 students, 58 this mo, 6.2% conv, 18.5 days, 2.1% refund, ₹1,73,942, positive sparkline)
     * Power Query & Automated ETL: Corporate Data Pipelines (Active, 640 students, 44 this mo, 5.8% conv, 11.0 days, 0.9% refund, ₹1,09,956)
     * Python for Business Dashboards & Analytics (Active, 500 students, 24 this mo, 4.1% conv, 22.0 days, 3.4% refund, ₹71,976)
   - Pagination, search filter, and "Download Table CSV" action.
